issues.description: ID generation using Date.now() and Math.random() may have collision risk in high-concurrency scenarios. Consider using cryptographically secure UUIDs or database-generated IDs for production systems.
issues.suggestion: Replace with crypto.randomUUID() or import a UUID library like 'uuid' for production-grade ID generation
